name: Disrespectful Child
overview: Scripture firmly commands honoring one's parents as a vital expression of obedience to God, promising long life as a blessing for such respect (Exodus 20:12). It also sternly warns against cursing or mocking parents, indicating severe consequences for such disrespect, including death and divine judgment (Leviticus 20:9; Proverbs 30:17). These commands emphasize the sacred role of the family and the serious spiritual and moral implications of a child's attitude toward their parents, reflecting the broader call to live under God's protection and guidance (Psalms 91:1). Jesus’ teaching in Matthew 11:25 highlights the humility and childlike receptivity that God honors, which contrasts sharply with rebellious or disrespectful behavior. Ultimately, God’s purpose is to conform believers to the image of His Son, which includes honoring parental authority as part of godly character (Romans 8:29).
